language.title: Language
language.intro: Changes apply immediately and are remembered on this device.
language.label: Display language
language.contribute: Applyer is translated by its community. A language missing or wrong? Corrections are welcome on the project's issue tracker.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: Changes apply immediately and are remembered on this device.
appearance.terminalNote: Terminal tab: the terminal itself updates immediately, but a CLI agent already running inside it (Codex, Claude, etc.) only detects light/dark once at startup — restart it after changing the theme if it looks off.
appearance.cssIntro: Injected live into the app as you type. It can only change how things look, not how they work — if it ever makes the UI unusable, press <1>{{shortcut}}</1> anywhere to clear it instantly.
appearance.replaceMessage: This overwrites what's currently in the custom CSS editor with the selected template.
appearance.clearMessage: This removes all custom CSS you've written. This can't be undone.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Every shortcut requires holding {{modifier}}, except function keys (F1–F24, which don't produce typed characters) — plain typing, including inside the terminal, is never intercepted.
shortcuts.conflictMessage_one: {{combo}} is currently bound to "{{commands}}". Setting it here removes it from that command.
shortcuts.conflictMessage_other: {{combo}} is currently bound to "{{commands}}". Setting it here removes it from those commands.
shortcuts.resetAllMessage: This restores every shortcut to its default binding, discarding any customization.

browser.intro: Applyer drives a Chromium-based browser to search and apply to jobs. By default it looks for your system's installed Chrome or Edge first, and only downloads its own copy if neither is found.
browser.devBuildNote: This is a development build — it always uses Playwright's bundled Chromium, regardless of the preference below. The preference only takes effect in a packaged build.
browser.unresolvedNote: Resolves the first time a browser is needed, e.g. searching or applying to a job.
browser.outro: Auto tries system Chrome, then Edge, then a one-time managed download. Picking Chrome or Edge specifically fails with an error (instead of silently trying something else) if that browser isn't installed. Managed download always uses Applyer's own downloaded copy.
browser.saved: Browser preference saved — takes effect the next time a browser is launched.

storage.intro: Everything stays on this computer either way — this only changes how it's stored on disk. Changing this re-writes your existing profile and documents in the new format.
storage.encryptedDescription: Locked using this computer's built-in secure storage — only readable on this device, by your user account.
storage.plaintextDescription: Stored as regular, readable files. Simpler to back up or inspect, but readable by anyone with access to this computer's files.
storage.encryptionUnavailable: Not available on this system (no OS keychain detected).
storage.changeMessageEncrypted: This will re-write your profile and uploaded documents in encrypted form. It may take a moment.
storage.changeMessagePlaintext: This will re-write your profile and uploaded documents in plain text form. It may take a moment.
storage.changed: Storage mode changed — your profile and documents were re-written in the new format.
storage.locationIntro: Where your database, documents, screenshots, and logs are kept. Applyer keeps running while a move is in progress.
storage.moveMessage: Move your database, documents, screenshots, and logs to "{{path}}"? This may take a moment and Applyer will keep running throughout.
storage.connectMessage: Switch to the Applyer database already stored in "{{path}}"? This replaces the currently active dataset with the selected one. Nothing is copied, deleted, or merged, so you can reconnect to the current location later.
storage.pickFailed: Could not choose a storage location.
storage.connectFailed: Failed to connect to that storage location.

recovery.title: Your storage location isn't available
recovery.help: Reconnect the drive or folder, then retry — or use the default location for now. You can switch back once your custom location is available again.
recovery.retryFailed: Could not retry the storage location.
recovery.inspectFailed: Could not inspect the default storage location.
recovery.useDefaultFailed: Failed to switch to the default location.
recovery.confirmMessageEmpty: This uses the default location until you reconnect your custom location and retry, or pick a new one in Settings.
recovery.confirmMessageExisting: The default location already has data in it — {{jobs}} jobs, {{documents}} documents. Using it now continues from that data; it won't merge with your custom location. You can switch back once your custom location is available again.

data.intro: Everything here stays on this computer — export writes a file you choose, import reads one you pick.
data.exportDescription: Save your job applications, exclusions, profile, and settings to a file — as one JSON bundle, or as a CSV table for spreadsheets.
data.importDescription: Restore data from a JSON file this app exported. New jobs and exclusions are added alongside what you already have; profile and settings can optionally be overwritten.
